blocks.text: Clustering milti julti cheezon ko un ki characteristics (khoobiyon, pehchan ki baaton) ki bunyad par groups mein rakhne ka tareeqa hai. Socho class ke students ko maths, science aur English mein performance (kitna achha kiya) ke hisab se groups mein baantna hai. Clustering aise groups banati hai jin mein milti julti performance wale students hon.
Misal: Performance ke hisab se students ki clustering
Farz karein paanch students ke maths aur English ke scores yeh hain:

blocks.caption: Paanch students ke Maths aur English scores

blocks.text: Clustering se in students ko in do subjects ki performance ke hisab se group kar sakte hain.
K-means Clustering

K-means clustering data ko group karne ke sab se saada aur mashhoor tareeqon mein se ek hai. Is mein pehle tay karna hota hai ke kitne groups (clusters) chahiye. Is misal mein do clusters: ek maths mein mazboot students ka, ek English mein mazboot students ka. Algorithm scores ke beech distance (faasla) naap kar milti julti performance wale students ko ek group mein rakhta hai. Basim aur Umer (maths mein achhe) ek group mein, aur Anie aur Tallat (English mein achhi) doosre group mein jayenge.
K-means step by step
Step 1: Clusters ki ginti (K) chunein
K = 2 rakhte hain, yani students ko do clusters mein baantna hai: ek maths mein mazboot, ek English mein mazboot.
Step 2: Initial centers (shuru ke center points) rakhein
Do shuruati cluster centers chahiye, jo students ke scores mein se randomly (kisi bhi tarah) chune jate hain. Aasani ke liye do students ko center bana lete hain:

items: Center 1: Basim (85, 70), maths mein mazboot students ke liye.
Center 2: Tallat (40, 85), English mein mazboot students ke liye.

blocks.text: Step 3: Har student ko sab se qareeb center ke saath rakhein
Har student ke scores ka dono centers se distance (faasla) nikalte hain. Is ka aam tareeqa Euclidean distance formula hai:
Har student ka Center 1 (Basim) aur Center 2 (Tallat) se faasla:
Basim: Center 1 tak faasla = 0 (woh khud center hai)
Tallat: Center 1 tak faasla ≈ 47.43 (Basim se uska faasla); Center 2 tak faasla = 0 (woh khud center hai)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein yeh ghaltiyan hain: (1) centers ko “Center 1 (Ali)” aur “Center 2 (Ayesha)” likha hai, jabke centers Basim aur Tallat hain. (2) Kai faasle ghalat hain: Basim–Center 2 aur Tallat–Center 1 dono 46.1 likhe (sahi 47.43), Umer–Center 1 = 46.1 (sahi 7.07), Umer–Center 2 = 57.01 (sahi 53.85), Anie–Center 2 = 10.29 (sahi 11.18). Tallat ke liye “woh center hai” Center 1 par likha hai, jabke woh Center 2 hai.
Faasle nikalne ke baad har student ko sab se qareeb center ke saath rakhte hain:

items: Basim, Umer aur Maliha Center 1 (Basim) ke qareeb hain, is liye Cluster 1 (maths mein mazboot) mein.
Anie aur Tallat Center 2 (Tallat) ke qareeb hain, is liye Cluster 2 (English mein mazboot) mein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Maliha ko Cluster 2 (Tallat wala) mein rakhti hai. Lekin kitab ke apne hisab mein Maliha ka Center 1 se faasla 26.92 aur Center 2 se 32.02 hai, yani woh Center 1 ke qareeb hai. Is liye Maliha Cluster 1 mein jati hai.
Step 4: Centers dobara nikalein
Ab har cluster ke students ke scores ka average (average position) nikal kar naye centers bante hain:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Maliha ko ghalat cluster mein rakhne ki wajah se naye centers (87.5, 67.5) aur (50, 75) likhti hai. Sahi clusters se naye centers (78.3, 65) aur (45, 82.5) hain.
Step 5: Step 3 aur 4 dohrayein jab tak centers ruk na jayein

Naye centers se har student ka faasla dobara nikalte hain aur zaroorat ho to group badalte hain. Yeh tab tak chalta hai jab tak centers badalna band na kar dein; tab clusters stable (pakke, ab nahi badalte) hain.

Is misal mein naye centers se Maliha Center 1 se taqreeban 19.0 aur Center 2 se 27.0 door hai, is liye woh Cluster 1 mein hi rehti hai; koi student group nahi badalta. Aakhri clusters: Cluster 1: Basim, Umer aur Maliha (maths mein achhe); Cluster 2: Anie aur Tallat (English mein achhe).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Step 5 mein likhti hai ke Maliha English wale cluster mein rehti hai, lekin agle hi jumle mein aakhri nateeja Cluster 1: Basim, Umer aur Maliha deti hai. Aakhri nateeja sahi hai; Step 5 wala jumla ghalat hai.

blocks.alt: Graph: x-axis par Math score, y-axis par English score. Neele points Basim (85, 70), Umer (90, 65) aur Maliha (60, 60) ek cluster hain, jin ka center (78.3, 65) X se dikhaya gaya. Orange points Anie (50, 80) aur Tallat (40, 85) doosra cluster hain, center (45, 82.5).
blocks.caption: K-means (K = 2): paanch students ke do clusters aur un ke centers (hamara apna diagram; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.text: Khud chala kar dekhein

Yeh program K-means ka ek round chalata hai: har student ka dono centers se Euclidean distance (faasla), qareeb wala cluster, phir naye centers. center_1, center_2 ya kisi student ke scores badal kar Run karein.

students = {"Basim": (85, 70), "Umer": (90, 65), "Anie": (50, 80), "Tallat": (40, 85), "Maliha": (60, 60)}
center_1 = (85, 70)   # (maths, english)
center_2 = (40, 85)

import math

cluster_1, cluster_2 = [], []
for name, (x, y) in students.items():
    d1 = math.sqrt((center_1[0] - x) ** 2 + (center_1[1] - y) ** 2)
    d2 = math.sqrt((center_2[0] - x) ** 2 + (center_2[1] - y) ** 2)
    group = 1 if d1 <= d2 else 2
    (cluster_1 if group == 1 else cluster_2).append(name)
    print(f"{name:<7} to center 1: {d1:6.2f}  to center 2: {d2:6.2f}  -> cluster {group}")

for number, members in [(1, cluster_1), (2, cluster_2)]:
    if members:
        mx = sum(students[n][0] for n in members) / len(members)
        my = sum(students[n][1] for n in members) / len(members)
        print("Cluster", number, members, "new center =", (round(mx, 1), round(my, 1)))

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"students = {...}": dictionary; har naam ke saath (maths, english) scores ka jora (tuple).
"center_1 = (85, 70)" aur "center_2 = (40, 85)": dono clusters (groups) ke shuru wale center.
"cluster_1, cluster_2 = [], []": do khali lists jin mein naam jayenge.
"for name, (x, y) in students.items():": har student ka naam aur dono scores (x = maths, y = english) nikalta hai.
"d1 = math.sqrt(...)" aur "d2 = ...": Euclidean distance (seedha faasla) = farq ke squares ke jama ka square root, dono centers se.
"group = 1 if d1 <= d2 else 2": jo center qareeb ho, student usi cluster mein; barabar faasle par cluster 1.
"(cluster_1 if group == 1 else cluster_2).append(name)": naam sahi list mein jor diya jata hai. f-string mein ":<7" aur ":6.2f" sirf columns seedhe rakhne aur 2 decimal dikhane ke liye hain.
Doosra loop: har cluster ke members ke maths aur english ka average nikal kar naya center banata hai ("if members:" khali cluster par taqseem se bachata hai).
Output: Basim (0.00 / 47.43), Umer (7.07 / 53.85) aur Maliha (26.93 / 32.02) cluster 1 mein; Anie (36.40 / 11.18) aur Tallat (47.43 / 0.00) cluster 2 mein. Aakhir mein "Cluster 1 ['Basim', 'Umer', 'Maliha'] new center = (78.3, 65.0)" aur "Cluster 2 ['Anie', 'Tallat'] new center = (45.0, 82.5)".
Khud try karein: center_2 = (60, 60) kar ke Run karein: ab Maliha cluster 2 mein chali jayegi; cluster 1 ka naya center (87.5, 67.5) aur cluster 2 ka (50.0, 75.0) aayega.

blocks.explanation: (b) data ko similarity (milta julta hone) ki bunyad par clusters mein group karna; (b) banne wale clusters ki ginti. Steps: K chunein; K initial centers (centroids, yani cluster ke center points) rakhein, aksar data mein se randomly (bina soche, kisi bhi tarah) chune hue K points (yahan Basim aur Tallat); har point ko Euclidean distance se sab se qareeb centroid ke saath rakhein; har centroid ko us ke points ke average par le jayein; jab tak centroids badalna band na karein, yeh dono kaam dohrate rahein.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: K-means (K = 2): Cluster 1 Basim, Umer, Maliha, center ≈ (78.3, 65); Cluster 2 Anie, Tallat, center (45, 82.5).
Kitab ke Step 3 aur 4 mein faasle, naam aur Maliha ka cluster ghalat; aakhri nateeja sahi.
